requirements.quote:
case client_hello:
                   ProtocolVersion versions<2..254>;
requirements.condition: when encoding or parsing supported_versions in a ClientHello
requirements.required_behavior: encode versions as a ProtocolVersion vector whose encoded content length is between 2 and 254 bytes
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode an empty vector or a vector outside the 2-to-254-byte range
requirements.why_checkable: The ClientHello extension parser and serializer expose the vector length.

requirements.quote:
case server_hello: /* and HelloRetryRequest */
                   ProtocolVersion selected_version;
requirements.condition: when encoding or parsing supported_versions in a ServerHello or HelloRetryRequest
requirements.required_behavior: encode exactly one ProtocolVersion selected_version value
requirements.why_checkable: The extension message variant and fixed-width ProtocolVersion field are directly inspectable.

requirements.quote:
The extension contains a list of supported
   versions in preference order, with the most preferred version first.
requirements.condition: when a client constructs the supported_versions list
requirements.required_behavior: order versions by preference with the most preferred version first
requirements.why_checkable: The serialized list order can be compared with the configured version preference order.

requirements.quote:
Implementations of this specification MUST send this extension in the
   ClientHello containing all versions of TLS which they are prepared to
   negotiate
requirements.condition: when an implementation of this specification sends a ClientHello
requirements.required_behavior: send the supported_versions extension
requirements.why_checkable: Generated ClientHello messages can be inspected for extension presence.

requirements.quote:
Implementations of this specification MUST send this extension in the
   ClientHello containing all versions of TLS which they are prepared to
   negotiate
requirements.condition: when constructing the ClientHello supported_versions extension
requirements.required_behavior: include every TLS version the implementation is prepared to negotiate
requirements.forbidden_behavior: omit a configured negotiable TLS version
requirements.why_checkable: The offered list can be compared with the implementation's enabled negotiable versions.

requirements.quote:
(for this specification, that means minimally 0x0304, but
   if previous versions of TLS are allowed to be negotiated, they MUST
   be present as well).
requirements.condition: when an implementation of this specification constructs supported_versions
requirements.required_behavior: include version 0x0304
requirements.why_checkable: The offered version code points are directly observable in ClientHello.

requirements.quote:
(for this specification, that means minimally 0x0304, but
   if previous versions of TLS are allowed to be negotiated, they MUST
   be present as well).
requirements.condition: when previous TLS versions are enabled for negotiation
requirements.required_behavior: include those enabled previous versions in supported_versions
requirements.forbidden_behavior: negotiate an enabled previous version without offering it
requirements.why_checkable: The configured legacy-version set can be compared with the emitted extension.

requirements.quote:
If this extension is not present, servers which are compliant with
   this specification and which also support TLS 1.2 MUST negotiate
   TLS 1.2 or prior as specified in [RFC5246], even if
   ClientHello.legacy_version is 0x0304 or later.
requirements.condition: a compliant server supports TLS 1.2 and receives a ClientHello without supported_versions
requirements.required_behavior: negotiate TLS 1.2 or an earlier version according to RFC 5246 regardless of a legacy_version value of 0x0304 or later
requirements.why_checkable: A handshake test can omit the extension, vary legacy_version, and observe the selected protocol.

requirements.quote:
If this extension is present in the ClientHello, servers MUST NOT use
   the ClientHello.legacy_version value for version negotiation
requirements.condition: the ClientHello contains supported_versions
requirements.why_checkable: Conflicting legacy_version and extension values can reveal which input drives selection.

requirements.quote:
and MUST
   use only the "supported_versions" extension to determine client
   preferences.
requirements.condition: the ClientHello contains supported_versions
requirements.required_behavior: determine client version preferences only from supported_versions
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use another ClientHello field to infer the client's version preferences
requirements.why_checkable: Version selection can be tested with conflicting legacy and extension inputs.

requirements.quote:
Servers MUST only select a version of TLS present in
   that extension
requirements.condition: a server selects a TLS version from a ClientHello containing supported_versions
requirements.required_behavior: select a version present in the client's supported_versions list
requirements.forbidden_behavior: select a version absent from the client's supported_versions list
requirements.why_checkable: The negotiated version can be compared with the exact offered list.

requirements.quote:
and MUST ignore any unknown versions that are present
   in that extension.
requirements.condition: supported_versions contains an unknown version code point
requirements.required_behavior: ignore the unknown version
requirements.forbidden_behavior: select or fail solely because of the unknown version
requirements.why_checkable: Unknown code points can be injected while observing selection and alert behavior.

requirements.quote:
Implementations of TLS 1.3 which choose to support prior
   versions of TLS SHOULD support TLS 1.2.
requirements.condition: a TLS 1.3 implementation supports any prior TLS version
requirements.required_behavior: support TLS 1.2
requirements.why_checkable: The enabled protocol-version set can be inspected or exercised.

requirements.quote:
Servers MUST be prepared to
   receive ClientHellos that include this extension but do not include
   0x0304 in the list of versions.
requirements.condition: a server receives supported_versions without 0x0304
requirements.required_behavior: parse and process the ClientHello without treating the absence of 0x0304 as a malformed extension
requirements.why_checkable: A syntactically valid list containing only other versions can exercise this parser path.

requirements.quote:
A server which negotiates a version of TLS prior to TLS 1.3 MUST set
   ServerHello.version
requirements.condition: a server negotiates a TLS version prior to TLS 1.3
requirements.required_behavior: set ServerHello.version to carry the negotiated legacy-version value
requirements.why_checkable: The legacy ServerHello field is directly observable on the wire.

requirements.quote:
and MUST NOT send the "supported_versions"
   extension.
requirements.condition: a server negotiates a TLS version prior to TLS 1.3
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send the supported_versions extension in ServerHello
requirements.why_checkable: The negotiated version and ServerHello extension list are observable.

requirements.quote:
A server which negotiates TLS 1.3 MUST respond by sending
   a "supported_versions" extension
requirements.condition: a server negotiates TLS 1.3
requirements.required_behavior: send supported_versions in the ServerHello
requirements.why_checkable: A TLS 1.3 ServerHello can be inspected for extension presence.

requirements.quote:
a "supported_versions" extension containing the selected version
   value (0x0304).
requirements.condition: a server negotiates TLS 1.3
requirements.required_behavior: set supported_versions.selected_version to 0x0304
requirements.why_checkable: The selected_version field has a fixed expected wire value.

requirements.quote:
It MUST set the ServerHello.legacy_version field to
   0x0303 (TLS 1.2).
requirements.condition: a server negotiates TLS 1.3
requirements.required_behavior: set ServerHello.legacy_version to 0x0303
requirements.why_checkable: The fixed legacy_version wire value can be asserted in a TLS 1.3 ServerHello.

requirements.quote:
Clients MUST check for this extension prior to
   processing the rest of the ServerHello
requirements.condition: a client processes a ServerHello
requirements.required_behavior: check for supported_versions before semantically processing the rest of ServerHello
requirements.forbidden_behavior: process other ServerHello semantics before determining whether supported_versions is present
requirements.why_checkable: Control flow can be inspected or fault-injected to establish extension-check ordering.

requirements.quote:
If this
   extension is present, clients MUST ignore the
   ServerHello.legacy_version value
requirements.condition: ServerHello contains supported_versions
requirements.required_behavior: ignore ServerHello.legacy_version when determining the selected version
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use ServerHello.legacy_version as the selected version
requirements.why_checkable: A conflicting legacy_version can verify that the client ignores it.

requirements.quote:
and MUST use only the
   "supported_versions" extension to determine the selected version.
requirements.condition: ServerHello contains supported_versions
requirements.required_behavior: determine the selected version only from supported_versions
requirements.forbidden_behavior: derive the selected version from another ServerHello field
requirements.why_checkable: Conflicting fields allow the selected-version input source to be tested.

requirements.quote:
If
   the "supported_versions" extension in the ServerHello contains a
   version not offered by the client or contains a version prior to
   TLS 1.3, the client MUST abort the handshake with an
   "illegal_parameter" alert.
requirements.condition: ServerHello supported_versions selects a version the client did not offer
requirements.error_behavior: abort the handshake with an illegal_parameter alert
requirements.why_checkable: A server response can select an unoffered version and the emitted alert can be observed.

requirements.quote:
If
   the "supported_versions" extension in the ServerHello contains a
   version not offered by the client or contains a version prior to
   TLS 1.3, the client MUST abort the handshake with an
   "illegal_parameter" alert.
requirements.condition: ServerHello supported_versions selects a version prior to TLS 1.3
requirements.error_behavior: abort the handshake with an illegal_parameter alert
requirements.why_checkable: A pre-TLS-1.3 selected_version can be injected and the exact alert asserted.
